beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then compare the minimal charter with the diagnostic matrix for examining actual organizations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The matrix asks observable questions and refuses to hide fatal failures inside a flattering average.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full book connects those tests with examples, funding, cultural practice, and AI.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to examine whether organized belonging enlarges people’s agency while preserving their freedom to leave.
